_comment: Bubblewrap / TWA configuration for the DataLens Android APK.
The values below are the real build targets. Two MUST be changed before
generating a release APK: host and startUrl must point at your deployed
HTTPS origin, and the certificate fingerprint must match assetlinks.json.
See APK-BUILD.md for the exact procedure.
name: DataLens — Investment Research

whyTrustedWebActivity: A TWA renders the installed PWA inside a verified Chrome WebView.
It requires assetlinks.json to match the APK signing certificate.
Without a matching fingerprint the app opens in a plain browser tab
with a warning banner — the app still works, it just loses the
standalone chrome and a small amount of startup performance.
